Plugin.Name: Mover Dashboard
Plugin.Overview:
Adds a Mover tab that shows what the mover is doing while it runs.
You see the file being moved, from which pool to which drive, with its progress, speed and time left; the next files in the mover's own order and what is left in each share; how much is waiting on each cache pool; read and write activity, busy time and temperature for every drive, with the icon of the app that has each file open; data written but still in memory; and the array write speed over the last 15 minutes, with a mark at each new file. That makes it easy to see why a move is slow, for example when Plex or another container is reading from the drive being written.
The plugin only reads system state. It does not start, stop or change the mover. Turn on Settings, Mover Settings, Mover progress for exact totals and ETA.
